doc.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023

title: Staying healthy and a nutrition certification
summary: She sleeps and eats carefully on tour and earned a Nutrition and Fitness Certification.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: What do you do to keep yourself healthy?

Ooh. I try to get sleep though that’s not always successful when you’re on three-week tours which is what I’m looking at right now. You just drop when you can. I try to eat well, that’s been more and more important, the more — I won’t say older, but the wiser I © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

get. As Maya Angelou says when you know better do better. So I try to do better by nutrition. In fact I went ahead and — I went got a Nutrition and Fitness Certificate, certification, just so I can educate myself on vitamins and supplements and different types of foods and how your body works with that. And that was really important for me. Plus I love to learn. I read a lot. So I messed around I got myself certified. That was pretty wild. Didn’t expect to even pass that test but I guess I test well too, the wiser I get.

Yeah it’s huge. Mind and body, soul. Mind, body and spirit. You want to keep all of that working together. That’s important, especially for a singer and these days any or everything is floating around.
